Name: CUTSCENE_WEATHER_OVERRIDE_GPARAM_ID_CONVERT_PARAM_ST
Description: Picks which weather-override GPARAM file a cutscene loads. Row ID = the weather type used in the cutscene (see CutsceneGparamWeatherParam: 0 Sunny, 20 Rain, 50 Fog …). The cutscene loads sAA_BB_CCCC_WeatherOverride_NN.gparam next to its own sAA_BB_CCCC.gparam.

Fields.Name: Weather Override GPARAM Number
Fields.Description: Number NN of the cutscene's sAA_BB_CCCC_WeatherOverride_NN.gparam file used for this weather (two digits, 5 → 05). No row for the weather: 0.
